A tiny max_image_size does not crash conversion even when the image exceeds the limit

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_images\":true,\"max_image_size\":10}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Tiny limit: <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"></p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
